extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy outlines Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) code 77427.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

extracted_content.title: Sessions and Fractions
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy > Sessions and Fractions
extracted_content.content: CPT code 77427 may only be submitted for five sessions, regardless of the actual time period in which the services were furnished. Multiple fractions representing two or more treatment sessions furnished on the same day may be counted separately only if there was a distinct break between same-day therapy sessions, and only if the fractions are of a character usually furnished on different days. Humana plans deny, as inappropriately billed, charges for fewer than five sessions. Exception: A provider may submit CPT code 77427 for three or four sessions at the end of a course of treatment. Humana plans deny, as inappropriately billed, charges at the end of a course of treatment for fewer than three sessions.

extracted_content.title: Units
extracted_content.content: The billing provider must submit each unit of five sessions as a distinct single-unit charge. For a three-session unit or four-session unit at the end of a course of treatment, the billing provider must submit a single-unit charge distinct from all other units. Humana plans allow no more than one unit per charge and deny any additional unit(s) as inappropriately billed.

extracted_content.title: Service Dates
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy > Service Dates
extracted_content.content: Humana plans require providers to submit each charge for CPT code 77427 with a "from" date representing the date of the first session of the charge and a "to" date representing the date of the last session of the charge.

extracted_content.title: Note
extracted_content.content: A provider must submit a charge for CPT code 77427 with a note indicating the number of fractions performed. Use the following syntax in Loop 2400 in the 837 electronic transaction: "NTE✽ADD✽X FRACTION(S)~". For example, if five fractions were performed, enter "NTE✽ADD✽5 FRACTIONS~". If one fraction was performed, enter "NTE✽ADD✽1 FRACTION~".

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

CPT code 77427 may only be submitted for five sessions, regardless of the actual time period in which the services were furnished. Multiple fractions representing two or more treatment sessions furnished on the same day may be counted separately only if there was a distinct break between same-day therapy sessions, and only if the fractions are of a character usually furnished on different days. Humana plans deny, as inappropriately billed, charges for fewer than five sessions. Exception: A provider may submit CPT code 77427 for three or four sessions at the end of a course of treatment. Humana plans deny, as inappropriately billed, charges at the end of a course of treatment for fewer than three sessions.

The billing provider must submit each unit of five sessions as a distinct single-unit charge. For a three-session unit or four-session unit at the end of a course of treatment, the billing provider must submit a single-unit charge distinct from all other units. Humana plans allow no more than one unit per charge and deny any additional unit(s) as inappropriately billed.

Humana plans require providers to submit each charge for CPT code 77427 with a "from" date representing the date of the first session of the charge and a "to" date representing the date of the last session of the charge.

A provider must submit a charge for CPT code 77427 with a note indicating the number of fractions performed. Use the following syntax in Loop 2400 in the 837 electronic transaction: "NTE✽ADD✽X FRACTION(S)~". For example, if five fractions were performed, enter "NTE✽ADD✽5 FRACTIONS~". If one fraction was performed, enter "NTE✽ADD✽1 FRACTION~".
